description: A conditional whose antecedent the BASE disproves: the criterion applies where a topic transport was previously configured, and this repository never had one. A correct account does not refuse it. This is the exact class that failed a live run three times over.

criteria.text: Every topic-transport publisher and consumer configuration uses the required subscription shortening and websocket transport, where the topic transport was previously configured.
criteria.because: The base configured a queue transport and never a topic transport, so the criterion's condition holds nowhere and there is nothing it can be violated by.
